title: Traffic Sign - New
description: Use this service request to request the installation of a new traffic sign or to request the removal of a sign. **Signs for trails and trail crossings must be submitted to the Park & Recreation department using “Park Maintenance/Misc – PKR”. Signs include - school zone, dip, yield, stop, no parking, one way, speed limit, and street name blades. **A name, address and daytime phone are required. ** Signs for Buildings/Parking lots are the owner's responsibility. Highway signs contact TXDOT. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 35 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to install or remove a traffic sign on a Dallas street.
actions.why: For installing a new traffic sign or removing an existing sign on a Dallas city street, such as a stop, yield, school-zone, speed-limit, no-parking, one-way, or street-name sign. The 311 request form separates signs from signals, asks the sign type, and requires a name, address, and daytime phone.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Traffic Sign - New" requests is not for signs for trails or trail crossings, signs on buildings or parking lots, or highway signs. If the request is for a signal rather than a sign, then consider the "Traffic Signal - New" 311 request suggested by the Dallas 311 website. If a trail or trail crossing needs a sign, then submit a "Park Maintenance/Misc" 311 request instead. If the sign is on a highway, then contact TxDOT.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Sign - New"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Sign - New"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to install or remove a traffic signal.
actions.why: For requesting a new traffic signal where none has existed or removing an existing traffic signal. People who select Signal in the "Traffic Sign - New" form see a "Traffic Signal - New" service suggestion. The public "Traffic Signal - New" service has an online request form for new signals or removal.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal - New"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal - New"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a sign at a trail or trail crossing.
actions.why: For a traffic sign needed on a trail or at a trail crossing. The description for "Traffic Sign - New" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs these signs to "Park Maintenance/Misc". The public "Park Maintenance/Misc" service has an online request form for park and trail maintenance concerns.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Parks and Trails" > Choose "Park Maintenance/Misc"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Parks and Trails" > Choose "Park Maintenance/Misc"

actions.tagline: Contact TxDOT about a highway traffic sign.
actions.why: For a highway sign. The description for "Traffic Sign - New" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs highway sign concerns to TxDOT.
